title: From a Hackathon Idea to the Google Play Store
summary: Frésko brought my team to the grand finals of the SP Batey Hackathon in 2024. Two years later, it became StillGood, a real app on the Google Play Store.
notes: DRAFT written from the Frésko and StillGood case studies. Add: what the judges said, what you changed from the hackathon design and why, your teammates' names if they're happy to be named.
